notes: The walk was shallow (camera denied), so every screen past home is from the code notes: mark objects, the object (labels, box number, re-photo, delete) and the box-labels drawer; search results are counted as part of home, the system camera and the permission dialog are not counted, and backup is left out because no entry was found. Creation on the mark screen is not counted as a repeat; no screen edits a thing outside its home. One step per tap, and tapping a field and typing into it is one step. Move and label editing were never seen on screen, so the fewest-tap reading is used (open object, act, type, back; no separate save). R06-R08 are null: objects are marked by hand, nothing is recognised and there are no counts. R10 is null (one level of boxes, no map), R114 and R115 null (no prices). R11 uses a label for the season and a box number for closet and storage. Recall marks a box number typed from memory (no box list) and a label retyped with no suggestions.
